notes.title: 🥖🥐The Edge of Allegoria is Steam Deck verified and est en français
notes.content:
[h3]Hey kid, [/h3][h3]Envie d'aventure ? [/h3][p]You didn't understand a single word? Don't worry, most of the team don't either, but we have good news for those who have mastered the beautiful language of the French:[/p][p][/p][h2]The Edge of Allegoria now has a full French localisation![/h2][h2][/h2][p][/p][p]So tell all your French friends about it, or learn it yourself - now you have the best reason why ;) [/p][p]And if you want to play the game on the go with your Steam Deck, you can do that too, as we are now officially verified!!!
(Not like it wasn't playable before, but hey, now we have a nice green check mark ✅) [/p][p][/p][p]Last but not least, to quote the creative mind behind the game: [/p][p][i]"It's pretty Clair that people enjoy French turn-based RPGs, no matter how Obscur they are, so we thought we'd join in on the Expedition"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006151/dda7401fc705b818452806ceca90ef7a0a621678.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: The Edge of Allegoria now has a full French localisation!
And if you want to play the game on the go with your Steam Deck, you can do that too, as we are now officially verified!!!

notes.title: NEXT FEST, NEXT QUEST - New, extended demo of The Edge of Allegoria
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Next Fest is here, and we are part of it! [/h2]

As we all know, it's again the time when Steam celebrates great, new games by showcasing interesting demos for you to try out. 

So now is the perfect time to give The Edge of Allegoria a try! 
No matter if you haven't played the previous demo or finished it with all its secret dungeons and bosses, the new demo has something for everyone!

- the complete beginning of the game with some new features 
- a new city and some new locations
- new items and skills
- new enemies and boss

Grab the demo today and enjoy the jokes, the action, and the green graphics!  

And if you feel extra generous, leave us a review on the demo page so we can keep improving the game even more!
